Well, if i understand it right previously we had 100x cap, but after lava fixed Value GMO new cap is 10 000x. And we can easily reach it by investing into Value GMO to ~2% per 10k crops and about 100 points in land ranks. But when we do bean trades plot with huge OG/ticket, we lose all 10k GMO Stacks. Does cap stayed the same(100x) when we don't have any 10k GMO Stacks? I mean is it reasonable to push production boost upgrades in land ranks and product doubler upgrade in day market to have bigger multi without GMO Stacks. One of the possible strategy I'm thinking of resetting land ranks before bean trades, and spread all points among production boosts upgrades reaching multi to ~700x.

There are not 2 unique caps. You can work toward that 10kx cap with the previous sources of Value, land ranks and product doubler.

IMO though, your goal should be to collect at least 100k with no OG after a reset. That might mean starting with 36 stacks of Value/Super GMO or 0 depending on your playstyle. Then divide by number of plots: Are you planting all 36 plots the same, or splitting 6 plots for each seed? Then another division for product doubler, and yet another division for number of physical plants on the vine.

0 pre-stack, full 36 plots example:
100k / 36 plots / 4 from 300% PD / 6 crops on vine from +500% total Stronger Vines (including gem shop)
= value of ~116 needed

36 pre-stack, 6 plots example:
= value of ~695 needed, some of which can come from your GMO stacks

If you can reach 400% pd and/or 600% total Stronger Vines, the value needed can go further down.
